rollback_evidence: FortiOS 8.0.0 build0167, 2026-09-23: a one-shot automation stitch with a cli-script action restored create, update and delete of firewall address in one transaction; deleting the stitch before its time kept the change. The object recreated by the delete inverse receives a new uuid. The same mechanism and address operations were measured on FortiOS 7.6.7 build3704 on 2026-09-23. Execution always requires enrollment bound to the actual build.
